name: BED covered-fraction algebra
purpose: L1 interval algebra: covered fraction of A by B (100/300 = 0.3333; jaccard 0.25 is the trap).
prompt: I have two BED tracks. Track A: chr1 100 200, chr1 300 400, chr1 500 600. Track B: chr1 150 350. What fraction of track A's bases are covered by track B?

checks.desc: Class-b finding if the agent reports jaccard 0.25 as the answer (bedtools jaccard intersection 100 / union 400) instead of the asked covered fraction 100/300.
